{"nbformat":4,"nbformat_minor":0,"metadata":{"colab":{"provenance":[],"authorship_tag":"ABX9TyNwCXmrBqTEDl4ha2YdOYBv"},"kernelspec":{"name":"python3","display_name":"Python 3"},"language_info":{"name":"python"}},"cells":[{"cell_type":"code","execution_count":null,"metadata":{"id":"UqdfPvUU7wbB"},"outputs":[],"source":[]},{"cell_type":"markdown","source":["---\n","\n","# 📘 Math RAG Agent — Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Math Tutor\n","\n","*A JEE-level step-by-step math-solving agent powered by LangChain, OpenAI, Qdrant, and DSPy.*\n","\n","---\n","\n","## 🚀 Overview\n","\n","This project implements a **full Agentic-RAG system** that behaves like a **JEE mathematics professor**, capable of solving problems step-by-step, validating queries with guardrails, retrieving from a knowledge base, and falling back to web search when needed.\n","It also supports **human-in-the-loop feedback** and **benchmark evaluation**.\n","\n","The system runs fully inside a **LangChain-based pipeline**, with Qdrant vector search, DSPy guardrails, web search fallback, and GPT-4 level reasoning.\n","\n","---\n","\n","## ✨ Key Features\n","\n","### 🔒 1. Input Guardrails (DSPy)\n","\n","* Ensures the agent only answers **math-related academic** questions.\n","* Blocks harmful, irrelevant, or non-math prompts.\n","* Optional LLM-based classifier for deeper validation.\n","\n","### 📚 2. Knowledge-Base RAG\n","\n","* **Dataset:** JEEBench (HuggingFace) — Math subset\n","* **Vector DB:** Qdrant (Docker or Cloud)\n","* **Embeddings:** OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small`\n","* **Pipeline:** Documents → Chunking → Embeddings → Qdrant Index\n","* Performs **top-K vector similarity search** to reuse known questions + solutions.\n","\n","### 🌐 3. Web Fallback (Tavily Search)\n","\n","* When vector search confidence is low → automatically routes to web search.\n","* Uses **Tavily API** for accurate math-related search results.\n","* Web snippets are passed to GPT-4o for cleaned-up explanations.\n","\n","### 🧠 4. GPT-4o Step-by-Step Math Tutor\n","\n","* Generates full JEE-level solutions with:\n","\n","  * Numbered steps\n","  * Explanations\n","  * Final boxed answers\n","  * Cited sources when applicable\n","* Uses **LangChain ChatOpenAI**, deterministic mode (temp=0).\n","\n","### 🛡️ 5. Output Guardrails\n","\n","* Filters hallucinations\n","* Ensures final responses stay math-focused\n","* Sanitizes unsafe/unwanted content before returning to user\n","\n","### 👍 6. Human-in-the-Loop Feedback\n","\n","* Students can mark answers as 👍 / 👎\n","* All feedback is logged into a local JSON file (`feedback.json`) or SQLite\n","* Approved or corrected answers can be **reinjected into Qdrant** to continuously improve the KB\n","\n","### 📊 7. Benchmarking (JEEBench)\n","\n","* Benchmarked on **50 random JEEBench math questions**\n","* Current pipeline accuracy: **66%**\n","* Results saved to:\n","\n","  ```\n","  benchmark/results.csv\n","  ```\n","\n","### 🖥️ 8. Streamlit UI\n","\n","* Multi-tab interface:\n","\n","  * Ask Question\n","  * View Sources\n","  * Rate the Response\n","  * Explore Knowledge Base\n","  * Run Benchmarks\n","\n","---\n","\n","## 🏗️ Architecture Summary\n","\n","```\n","User → Guardrails → Agent Router → [Qdrant KB]\n","                                → [Web Search + MCP Extraction]\n","                                → LLM Synthesizer → Output Guardrails\n","                                → User Feedback → Reinforcement (KB Upsert)\n","```\n","![Untitled presentation.jpg](data:image/jpeg;base64,)\n","\n","\n","## 🔧 Tech Stack\n","\n","* **LangChain** — LLM orchestration\n","* **OpenAI GPT-4o / 4o-mini** — reasoning engine\n","* **OpenAI Embeddings** — KB vectorization\n","* **Qdrant** — vector database\n","* **DSPy** — guardrails & feedback scaffolding\n","* **Tavily API** — search\n","* **Streamlit** — UI\n","* **FastAPI** (optional) — API endpoints\n","* **Docker** — Qdrant hosting(problem arised)\n","\n","---\n","\n","## ▶️ How It Works\n","\n","1. User submits a math query.\n","2. Guardrails validate intent → block non-math / unsafe content.\n","3. Router checks vector similarity →\n","\n","   * **High match?** → Retrieve doc → Generate step-by-step answer (KB mode).\n","   * **Low match?** → Run Tavily search → Extract math snippets → LLM solution (Web mode).\n","4. Output is sanitized and displayed to user.\n","5. User provides feedback → corrected answer optionally added back to Qdrant.\n","\n","---\n","\n","## 📈 Results (Current Benchmark)\n","\n","* **Dataset:** JEEBench (Math)\n","* **Questions Evaluated:** __\n","* **Accuracy:** __\n","* **Modes:**\n","\n","  * __% KB retrieval\n","  * __% Web fallback\n","* **Benchmark file:** `benchmark/results.csv`\n"],"metadata":{"id":"225wnCPW7xpQ"}}]}
